purpose: Single Applicable Rate definition encodes four pricing eras keyed to First/Third/Fourth Amendment Effective Dates — multi-amendment same definition with query-date sensitivity. Recital colloquial "Applicable Margin" is non-controlling.
expectedFailClosedBehavior: Operative Applicable Rate for a query date must select the correct era subclause (A)/(B)/(C)/(D). If a referenced Amendment Effective Date is CONDITIONAL_UNRESOLVED, the engine must not invent which subclause applies. Do not substitute the recital term Applicable Margin for the defined term Applicable Rate.

sourcePointers.quote: (D) at any time on or following the Fourth Amendment Effective Date, (x) for any Adjusted Term SOFR Loan, 2.50% per annum, and (y) for any Base Rate Loan, 1.50% per annum

definedTermNote: Signed amend targets definition of Applicable Rate; recital Applicable Margin is colloquial only.
